	id = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf.20
	title = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_forgiveness_title
	desc = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_forgiveness_desc
	picture = GFX_politics_demands
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_forgive_accept
		trigger = {
			tag = KUW
			FROM = { tag = IRQ }
			IRQ = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_postwar = yes
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_forgiveness_pending
				NOT = { has_war_with = KUW }
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_principal_KUW > 0 }
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { factor = 15 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				tag = KUW
				FROM = { tag = IRQ }
				IRQ = {
					COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_postwar = yes
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_forgiveness_pending
					NOT = { has_war_with = KUW }
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_principal_KUW > 0 }
				}
			}
			IRQ = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_forgiveness_pending
				COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_forgive_kuwait_principal = yes
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_kuwait_forgave
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_forgive_reject
		ai_chance = { factor = 85 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				tag = KUW
				FROM = { tag = IRQ }
				IRQ = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_forgiveness_pending }
			}
			IRQ = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_forgiveness_pending
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_kuwait_refused_forgiveness
			}
		}
	}
}
